description: Before you even ask, the assistant has read across your hosting, billing, and domain records and found why your site is down — and staged a one-tap fix. You get the answer, not a menu.
One question, one answer drawn from every system behind your account — hosting, domain, billing, email — without you knowing or caring which system holds which fact.
The assistant traces exactly where things broke — the failed renewal, the expired card, the dunning notices you never saw — so the explanation is the real story, not a generic error.
It spots what went wrong that was not your fault — the billing notices went to an outdated email — and offers to fix the root cause, not just the symptom.
It forecasts both paths — fix now versus wait — showing the restoration timeline, the reactivation-fee deadline, and the loyalty credit, so you can act with the full picture.
With your approval it updates the card, corrects the billing email, processes the renewal with your loyalty credit, lifts the suspension, and turns on auto-renew — every step confirmed.
